metrics.profile_summary: Senior performance marketing expert and digital transformation leader with over 8 years of experience. Specialized in scaling revenue, managing multi-channel paid acquisition, and leading cross-functional teams to drive ROI and brand authority.

experience.description: Establishing marketing operations, website, and social media; executing paid acquisition strategies via Google and Facebook Ads while managing budgets and art direction.
Developed paid acquisition strategies across Google, Facebook, affiliates, and email; managed vendor relationships and prepared comprehensive performance reports.
Led a global remote team overseeing SEO, paid ads, and video production; implemented SOPs, KPIs, and managed hiring and budgets.
Led digital marketing team in creating brand presence; optimized paid acquisition campaigns and managed vendor relationships and reporting.
Spearheaded strategic campaigns, branding, and pricing; managed IT and production teams, developed hiring plans, and coordinated sales-marketing efforts.
Implemented B2B/B2C sales strategies and optimized high-converting websites; executed data-driven campaigns on Facebook, Google, and LinkedIn.
Scaled digital sales from $300k to $7.7M monthly; managed external agencies and executed comprehensive SEO/SEM and social media campaigns.

experience.role: Marketing Consultant / Senior Content Marketing Manager
experience.description: Managed B2B/B2C ad campaigns and content strategy; delegated tasks to creators and designers while optimizing lead magnets and landing pages.
Managed content teams and strategy for major clients like Unilever; oversaw SEO-optimized blogs and social media copy management.
Created SEO-optimized web content, DIY blogs, and product reviews for technical and medical websites.

strengths: Proven track record of scaling revenue (TPL Trakker)
Extensive experience in people and agency management
Deep expertise in integrated paid and organic campaigns
weaknesses: Educational background is in Electronics rather than Marketing/Business
evaluation.summary: The candidate is an overqualified performance marketer with significant leadership experience. He meets all key requirements for strategy, budget management, and team leadership, and has a demonstrated ability to drive massive revenue growth.
